objective: Load the frozen old full-model H67 ep35 pickle through the proven H9 compatibility namespaces, normalize it to a passive model_state_dict-only deployment checkpoint, and replace exactly the twelve MLP FC2 weight tensors by their per-output-row symmetric INT8 dequantized values. Export the exact INT8 codes, row scales and row-sum absolute bounds for a later FC2 and BN2 hardware identity bridge; do not touch FC1.

output.checkpoint_container: passive dictionary with exactly one model_state_dict member

quantization.scope: twelve tensors whose state key ends in .mlp.fc2.weight; no FC1, attention, Conv, ATLIF, BN, prediction-head parameter, buffer or non-target state entry may change
quantization.input_domain: binary for all twelve FC2 modules, proven by exactly one M51 record for every module and sample_id in 0..9
quantization.scale: max(abs(weight_row))/127, with scale=1 for an all-zero row
quantization.checkpoint_tensor: INT8 code multiplied by the float64 row scale and cast back to the original tensor dtype
quantization.hardware_payload: INT8 code, float64 row scale and int64 row sumabs

hard_gates.checkpoint_payload_supported: full-model nn.Module or one unambiguous state dictionary container
hard_gates.m51_each_weight_identity: shape, dtype, byte count and raw little-endian content SHA must match the loaded source tensor; bias must be null
hard_gates.m51_each_trace_shape: input last dimension equals in_features and output last dimension equals out_features

accuracy_gate_after_export.protocol: same frozen H67 ep35 valid825, no-running/current-batch BN, batch size 1, per-frame aggregation and sample order as the admitted baseline
accuracy_gate_after_export.failure_disposition: Do not admit FC2 INT8 deployment, M496 paper metrics, or BN2 bit-tight RTL; retain export as a negative PTQ experiment.

if_accuracy_passes.m496_identity: Use the NPZ INT8 codes as the frozen weight-memory payload for FC2 K1/K8/K1x8 functional, SAIF and PTPX replay.
if_accuracy_passes.m502_scope: Only BN2 receives a strict binary-input INT8 qdot bound from M509. FC1 remains outside this proof; the two stage-3 FC1 modules require Q24 fallback unless separately qualified.
if_accuracy_passes.required_before_rtl: Generate BN2 integer qdot extrema/overflow and address-timed raw write/replay trace, then re-run the M502 16/24 same-bus/same-lane gate.

fail_closed: Do not execute until an independent static reviewer verifies this r2 exporter and contract.
Do not execute concurrently with VCS, DC, Formality, PrimeTime or another project CPU/GPU experiment.
Do not quantize FC1 under this contract; two stage-3 FC1 modules are absent from the M51 binary-input trace.
Do not call the exported checkpoint accurate or deployable before the paired valid825 gate.
Do not place the generated checkpoint in ordinary Git.
